lesson_title: Four Drawers, Four Traps: Algebra Exam Essentials
hook_text: Divide x² = 5x by x and you get a CORRECT answer... and lose half your marks. Here's why.
clip_script: The trap the memo watches for: dividing both sides of x squared equals five x by x to get x equals five — that division throws away the solution x equals zero. Never divide by the variable; factorise instead: x times x minus five equals zero gives x equals zero or five.
visual_style: A split screen: one path dividing by x and watching the answer x equals zero shatter and vanish, the other path factorising and both answers landing safely with a memo tick on each.
mood: Cautionary, whodunit energy — the murdered solution revealed.
pacing: Quick setup of the tempting move, freeze-frame on the vanishing answer, brisk safe-method payoff.
call_to_action: Watch the full revision lesson and dodge all four mark-harvesting traps.
